summary: Adds the storefront building blocks relative to the delivery baseline and documents mobile homepage spacing and the active campaign background in the versioned Skill and MCP knowledge.
migration: Install the 0.2.0-candidate.4 / 0.1.0-candidate.8 pair and restart the project MCP. Follow the storefront composition section in DISTRIBUTION to set the mobile section gap and wire the HeroBanner color callback to the page gradient.
rollback: Restore the previously verified paired tarballs and consumer lockfile, revert imports and host styles added for that upgrade, then restart the project MCP.
visualAndBehavior: Compared with 0.2.0-candidate.3, the update documents the mobile 8px hero-to-shortcuts gap and the background transition when swiping campaigns or scrolling the page. Verify both in the browser.
